headline: Your calm trades make money and your revenge trades give it back, so this week's ideas focus on stopping tilt in the moment.

ideas.title: Live tilt guard
ideas.why: Today's report only catches revenge trades after the fact. With a read-only Binance API key, the bot could message you the moment you open a trade within 15 minutes of a loss or raise leverage, which is when it matters.

ideas.title: One-tap mood check before the first trade
ideas.why: Anti-tilt journal apps log mood and discipline each session. A /plan button (calm, rushed, angry, tired) would let the bot show which moods your losing days start with.

ideas.title: Discipline streak in the morning brief
ideas.why: Count the days in a row with no revenge trades and 8 trades or fewer. A streak is easier to protect than a rule is to remember.

watch: Telegram restricted Mini App methods to the Mini App's own domain from 20 July 2026. If the Scanner button ever misbehaves, check that the Mini App domain in @BotFather is datradingbot.netlify.app.
Binance Futures added USDⓈ-margined TradFi perpetuals (stocks and commodities) in June 2026. If they start appearing among the top movers, the scanner may need a crypto-only filter.
